senses.gloss: मैथुन- + ज्वर मैथुन- + ज्वर, m. wantonness, MBh. 13, 1516.

मैथिल मैथिल, i. e. मिथिला + अ,
 I. adj., f. ली, Born in, referring to, Mithilā, Utt. Rāmac. 110, 13.
 II. m. The king of Mithilā, Rām. 3, 53, 2.
 III. f. ली, A name of Sītā, ib. 3, 49, 55.

मैथुन मैथुन, i. e. मिथुन + अ,
 I. adj. Worn at a time of sexual intercourse, Man. 4, 116.
 II. n.
 1. Sexual intercourse, Hit. pr. d. 25, M.M.
 2. Marriage, holy union, Man. 3, 5 (perhaps adj. Being in accordance with a legitimate marriage).
 3. Matrimony, Pañc. ii. d. 101.
 4. Union.

मैथुनिन् मैथुनिन्, i. e. मैथुन + इन्, adj. sbst. One who has been connected with a woman, Man. 5, 144.
 --Comp.
मैथुन्य मैथुन्य, i. e. मैथुन + य, adj. Contracted for the purpose of amorous embraces, Man. 3, 32.
